paper.title_en: Pulsar timing response and observational constraints on continuous-spin gravity
paper.abstract_en: Continuous-spin particles form the most general massless integer-helicity irreducible representations of the Poincaré group, characterized by a dimensionful continuous-spin scale $ρ_g$ set by a nonzero Pauli--Lubanski invariant. A single continuous-spin representation contains an infinite tower of integer helicities $h\in\mathbb Z$ that mix under Lorentz boosts. Since continuous-spin effects are controlled by $α\equivρ_g/(\hbarω)$ at gravitational-wave angular frequency $ω$, nanohertz pulsar timing arrays are naturally sensitive to ultralow values of $ρ_g$. Starting from the gauge-invariant worldline coupling of linearized continuous-spin gravity, we derive the one-way pulsar timing redshift response and the overlap reduction function of an isotropic stochastic background for arbitrary integer helicity. We show that while photon propagation is modulated across all helicities, only the vector modes ($h=\pm1$) perturb the four-velocity of a static observer, and that the tensor modes ($h=\pm2$) smoothly recover the Hellings--Downs correlation of general relativity as $ρ_g/(\hbarω)\to 0$. Modeling an unpolarized $h=\pm2$ background in the solar-system barycentric frame and jointly fitting the NANOGrav 15-year data with pulsar red noise, we obtain the $95\%$ upper limits $ρ^{U}_g<7.03\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}$ and $ρ^{\log {U}}_g<4.79\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}$ under uniform and log-uniform priors, respectively. Under the uniform prior, we obtain $γ_{\mathrm{GW}} = 4.89^{+0.85}_{-0.96}$, which brings the spectral index closer to the canonical value $γ_{\rm GW}=13/3$ expected for circular SMBHBs than standard General Relativity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将连续自旋引力与脉冲星计时阵列观测结合：从规范不变的世界线耦合推导单程计时红移响应与任意整数螺旋度下的重叠约化函数，并联合拟合NANOGrav 15年数据给出连续自旋标度上限。理论构造与观测约束兼备，且直接给出Hellings-Downs极限与谱指数的修正，具备进一步阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时响应与对连续自旋引力的观测约束
decision.abstract_zh: 连续自旋粒子构成庞加莱群最一般的无质量整数螺旋度不可约表示，其特征是由非零Pauli–Lubanski不变量设定的、量纲为一的连续自旋标度$\rho_g$。单个连续自旋表示包含一个无限整数螺旋度$h\in\mathbb Z$的塔，且在洛伦兹助推下相互混合。由于连续自旋效应在引力波角频率$\omega$下由$\alpha\equiv\rho_g/(\hbar\omega)$控制，纳赫兹脉冲星计时阵列天然对超低$\rho_g$值敏感。我们从线性化连续自旋引力的规范不变世界线耦合出发，推导了单程脉冲星计时红移响应以及各向同性随机背景在任意整数螺旋度下的重叠约化函数。我们表明，虽然光子传播在所有螺旋度上均受到调制，但只有矢量模（$h=\pm1$）会扰动静态观测者的四速度，而张量模（$h=\pm2$）在$\rho_g/(\hbar\omega)\to 0$时平滑地恢复广义相对论的Hellings–Downs相关性。我们在太阳系质心系中对未极化的$h=\pm2$背景建模，并将NANOGrav 15年数据与脉冲星红噪声联合拟合，在均匀先验和对数均匀先验下分别得到$95\%$上限$\rho^{U}_g<7.03\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}$和$\rho^{\log {U}}_g<4.79\times10^{-23}\,\mathrm{eV}$。在均匀先验下，我们得到$\gamma_{\mathrm{GW}} = 4.89^{+0.85}_{-0.96}$，这使得谱指数比标准广义相对论更接近圆形超大质量双黑洞预期的正则值$\gamma_{\rm GW}=13/3$。
